patches.description: Disables Pairip signature, licensing, installer and store-dialog checks so Noji runs on AOSP without Google Play services.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes advertising identifiers and ad SDK components from Noji.

patches.name: Remove Trackers
patches.description: Removes analytics, install-referrer, crash, and diagnostics components from Noji.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Marks the existing Qonversion Premium entitlement as active.
